title: Line Spectral Estimation Using a G-Filter: Atomic Norm Minimization with Multiple Output Vectors
summary: We propose an atomic norm minimization (ANM) estimator of frequencies in a noisy complex sinusoidal signal that integrates Georgiou's filter bank (G-filter) with multiple output vectors (MOV). Unlike our previous work on the G-filter version of ANM which is restricted to a single filtered output vector, the proposed method in this paper uses MOV to improve data utilization and robustness of the estimate.
